title: Temporal Motif-Enhanced Contrastive Learning for Adaptive Anomaly Detection in Dynamic Networks

contributions.purpose: 动态网络自适应异常检测框架
contributions.mechanism: 显式时序 motif 提取 + 多尺度 GNN + 基于记忆的自适应对比学习
contributions.evaluation: 框架层面,无需大量标注/频繁重训
contributions.source_quote: integrating explicit temporal motif extraction into a multi-scale GNN architecture, combined with contrastive learning

contributions.purpose: 声称在真实数据集上超越 SOTA
contributions.mechanism: 在 CollegeMsg/Email-Eu-core/Higgs/Epinions 半监督离群打分
contributions.evaluation: 声称 15-30% 相对 F1 提升 over baseline 动态 GNN;但无结果表/无基线数字
contributions.source_quote: Our method showed a 15–30% relative improvement in F1-score over baseline dynamic GNNs, especially for anomalies with localized temporal bursts.

contributions.purpose: 合成数据上做超参消融
contributions.mechanism: batch size / edge factor / learning rate 消融
contributions.evaluation: 合成数据 validation F1 最高仅 0.58(batch16);自承过拟合与不稳定
contributions.source_quote: Table 1: Validation F1-scores at different batch sizes on a synthetic dataset.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Contrastive approaches learn embeddings by pulling representations of augmented or adjacent samples closer... We adapt such methods into a memory-based scheme that updates normal representations without requiring large labeled sets.

notes: 重大数据红旗——幻影/无支撑头条:摘要与结论主打'15-30% F1 提升 over SOTA(4 个真实数据集)',但正文 §6.4 只有一句叙述性声明,无 per-dataset 结果表、无任何基线数字、无自身方法数值;唯一有数字的实验(Table 1/Fig 1-2)全是合成数据超参消融,且最高 validation F1 仅 0.58 并自承'potential overfitting'。real-data 结论与展示证据严重脱节。checklist 却答 Yes 称结果可复现。
